title: A template kit rebuilt in a folder holding only the committed kit keeps its declared site fields and the looks of unchanged shots
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok, none skipped.
expect: An assemble with no site.json (a build's first one) writes the kit with the declared fields of the kit it replaces under declaredSite; the next assemble with site.json puts every declared field and noneWhy back under site, unchanged, and keeps no declaredSite.
keepLooks on a kit with no shot keeps the previous looks under looksWaiting; the next kit with the shots takes each look whose shot sha256 did not change, and keeps no looksWaiting.

tests: a build into a folder holding only the committed kit keeps its declared fields through the assemble before the site part
a rebuild in its own folder keeps the looks through the assemble that runs before any shot is taken
